mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation higher and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops by >2% m-o-m but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the HOUST series, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending slows.
failure_condition: HOUST drops by >10% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate, as measured by the FEDFUNDS series, signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in payroll employment, as measured by the PAYEMS series, signals a strengthening economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending rises.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises by >200k m-o-m but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in consumer prices, as measured by the CPIAUCSL index, signals rising inflation that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises above 3% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp widening of the spread between the federal funds rate and the unemployment rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS - UNRATE spread widens above 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.
